items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Matty And Glover Compton, Nettie Compton's husband, he was the pianist down there... Now, upstairs we sang the blues

ctx.x: -- went up to the -- not we, just I, went up to the Panama. The Panama was upstairs. They had an upstairs and they had a downstairs. Now, Bricktop, Cora Green, Matty

And Glover Compton, Nettie Compton's husband, he was the pianist down there. He played piano. Sat there with a big cigar in his mouth, and just sat sideways. He never played, [Sitting occasionally] He sat this way all the time and played. Never looked at the piano keys. Never. He never even glanced at the piano keys.
